evals.prompt: Add idiomatic Go documentation for this small library so another engineer can use it correctly. Review names and add appropriate Godoc and implementation comments. Keep all exported identifiers, signatures and runtime behavior unchanged. Do not add a README, examples or dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Useful public contracts with concise comments and no code narration or behavior changes.
assertions: Documents actual defaults, limits, filtering, ownership and concurrency without invented guarantees.
Avoids duplicated explanations and implementation narration; public identifiers and runtime behavior are preserved.

evals.prompt: Review this Go library for confusing names and overly verbose comments. Improve names and documentation while preserving every exported identifier, signature, operation contract and runtime behavior. Edit source only; do not add a README, examples or dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Compact accurate Godoc, a meaningful private parse name and no implementation narration.
assertions: Preserves input grammar, non-nil destination requirement, replacement/count behavior, usable state on failure, reader ownership and line-size constraint.
